INSERT INTO outbox_message (id, aggregate_id, aggregate_type, event_type, entity_id, payload, status, attempts, queue, created_at, claimed_at, sent_at, last_error) VALUES
(#{m.id}, #{m.aggregateId}, #{m.aggregateType}, #{m.eventType}, #{m.entityId}, #{m.payload}, #{m.status}, #{m.attempts}, #{m.queue}, #{m.createdAt}, #{m.claimedAt}, #{m.sentAt}, #{m.lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT attempts FROM outbox_message WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_message SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
UPDATE outbox_message SET status = 'PENDING', claimed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE outbox_message SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('SENT', 'FAILED')
UPDATE outbox_message SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'SENT'
